name: SSL-RUL
description: SSL-RUL introduces a self-supervised pretraining strategy for Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction in industrial machinery. The model uses masked sensor reconstruction as a pretext task, followed by fine-tuning on minimal labeled degradation data. Evaluated on NASA C-MAPSS FD001-FD004 datasets with state-of-the-art RMSE and Score metrics. Currently under review at Results in Engineering (Elsevier). Developed in collaboration with researchers at VIT Chennai CSE department.
reported_outcome: Paper Under Review. 48.6% RMSE improvement on C-MAPSS with reduced labeled data.
